create schema upgrade_evidence;
create table upgrade_evidence.before_state (name text primary key, rows jsonb);
do $$ declare name text; begin
  foreach name in array array['profiles','profile_private','connections','connection_requests','tasks','task_occurrences','completion_events','notifications','pets','pet_unlocks'] loop
    execute format('insert into upgrade_evidence.before_state select %L, coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by to_jsonb(t)::text), ''[]''::jsonb) from public.%I t', name, name);
  end loop;
end $$;
create table upgrade_evidence.encouragements as select id, occurrence_id, author_id, owner_id, reaction, message, visibility, created_at from public.encouragements;
